senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (औ उ) औयमु (यच्छति)
To stop, to cease, to refrain.
With नि prefixed,
1 To remove, to dispel.
2 To observe as a vow or religious rite.
3 To regulate, to restrain.
With उत्,
1 To rise, to mount on.
2 To make effort or exertion.
3 To lift up, to raise.
With वि and आङ्,
To exercise.
With सम् and नि,
To restrain. In some senses it takes the deponent form, as
with आङ्, prefix,
(आयच्छते)
To put forth, to use or employ any part of one's own body, as the hand, &c.
(आयच्छति)
1 To seize.
2 To go to, to proceed to.
With सम्,
(संयच्छते)
To heap together any thing that is one's own.
(संयच्छति)
To associate with.
With उप,
(उपयच्छते)
1 To marry.
2 To agree or accede to.
3 To master by learning.
r. 10th cl. (यमयति यामयति)
1 To feed, to give food to.
2 To restrain.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Twin, fellow, one of a pair or brace.
m. (-मः)
1 Restraining, controlling.
2 Forbearance, refraining.
3 Cessation, stop, conclusion, finish.
4 Religious restraint or obligation.
5 Penance, purification, the performance of those acts which remove impurity of any kind.
6 Any of the five acts or virtues, which constitute pure characters, as refraining from violence or injury, patience, sincerity, obedience to a spiritual teacher, and the observance of all purificatory ceremonies.
7 A festival.
8 A crow.
9 A name of the planet SATURN.
10 YAMA, the deity of Naraka or hell, where his capital is placed, in which he sits in judgment on the dead, and distributes rewards and punishments, sending the good to Svarga, and the wicked to the division of Naraka or Tartarus appropriated to their crimes: he corresponds with the Grecian god PLUTO, and the judge of hell MINOS, and in Hindu mythology is often identified with Death and Time: he is the son of SŪRYA or the sun, and brother of the personified YAMUNĀ or Jumna river.
n. (-मं)
A brace, a couple, a pair.
f. (-मी)
The Yamunā river.
E.
यम to restrain, &c., aff. अच् or अप्.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Relating to YAMA, done by him, ordered by him, &c.
(-मः)
1 The eighth part of a day, a watch of three hours.
2 Forbearance.
3 Cessation, term.
E.
या to go, (through the day,) मन् Uṇādi aff., or यम to restrain, aff. घञ् or यम, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Twin, fellow, one of a pair or twins.
m. (-कः)
A religious obligation or observance.
n. (-कं)
1 A species of alliteration, the repetition of similar words or syllables either in a similar or a dissimilar sense in various parts of a stanza, beginning, middle, or end of each hemistich, or pervading the whole verse: ten varieties are enumerated.
2 A couple of like articles; (in medicine,) serum and marrow: (in diet,) oil and ghee, &c.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-न्दी)
SAṂJÑĀ, the wife of the sun.
E.
यम YAMA, and कालिन्दी the Yamunā river; their mother.

m. (-टः)
An earthworm.
E.
यम YAMA, and कीट a worm.

m. (-ग्निः)
1 The saint JAMADAGNI, the father of the first RĀMA.
2 PARAŚURĀMA, son of the preceding.
E.
see जमदाग्नि, य being substituted for ज.

m. (-तः)
An infernal spirit, the messenger or minister of YAMA, employed to bring the souls of the dead to YAMA'S judgment seat, and thence conduct them to their final destination.
E.
यम YAMA, and टूत a messenger.

m. (-कः)
1 A crow.
2 A messenger or minister of YAMA.
f. (-का)
The tamarisk tree.
E.
कन् pleonasm or aff. of comparison, added to the last.

nf. (-तं-ता)
The lunar asterism Bharaṇī.
E.
यम YAMA, देवता deity, the deity or regent of this constellation.

n. (-नं)
1 Binding, confining.
2 Term, cessation, rest.
3 Controlling, restraining.
m. (-नः)
A name of YAMA.
E.
यम to restrain, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-का)
A wall or screen of cloth surrounding a tent.
E.
यम stop or check, aff. ल्युट्, कन् added, fem. form.

m. (-यः)
Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.)
E.
यम YAMA, and प्रिय beloved.

f. (-नी)
The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river.
E.
यम YAMA, and भगिनी sister.

m. (-थः)
A buffalo.
E.
यम YAMA, and रथ a car.

m. (-राट्)
YAMA, the Indian PLUTO.
E.
यम YAMA, and राज् ruler; also with a final vowel यमराज m. (-जः.)

n. (-लं)
A pair, a brace, a couple.
f. (-ली)
A sort of dress, a body and petticoat.
(-ला)
Violent hiccough.
E.
यम to refrain, to cease, aff. कलच्.

n. (-लं)
A pair, a couple, a brace.
E.
यमल the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.

m. (-हा)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
यमलार्जुन a tree so named in the forest of Vṛndāvana, and हन् destroyer.

m. (-नः)
A buffalo.
E.
यम YAMA, and वाहन vehicle.

n. (-तं)
One of the duties of royalty, punishing offences without regard to persons, or without partiality or prejudice.
E.
यम the judge of Tartarus, and व्रत observance.

n. (-भं)
The court or tribunal of Yama.
E.
यम, and सभा assembly.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging to the court of Yama.
E.
यमसभ, and छ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made over to, devoted to, or sent to YAMA.
E.
यम with साति aff., and कृत made.

f. (-सा)
1 The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
यम YAMA, and स्वसृ the sister.

f. (-नी)
A sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.)
E.
यम YAMA, आङ् before नी to obtain, aff. अण् and ङीष्; with ण्वुल् aff. यमानिका; it is more usually read यवानी, and यवानिका.

m. (-कः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
यम YAMA, and अन्तक destroyer.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Who or what restrains, checks, &c.
m. (-मी)
A sage, who has subdued his senses.
E.
यम restraint, and इनि aff.

f. (-ना)
The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river, which rises on the south side of the Himāla range, at a short distance to the north-west of the source of the Ganges, and which after a course of about 378 miles falls into that river immediately below Allahabad; in mythology, the personified river is considered as the daughter of SŪRYA, and sister of YAMA.
E.
यम to stop, (at the Ganges,) and उनन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Relating to the Yamunā river.
n. (-नं)
Antimony, or rather the sulphuret of antimony, generally used as an application to darken the eyelashes, and strengthen the eyes.
E.
यमुना the Jumna river, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
SŪRYA, or the sun.
E.
यमुना the river, and जनक parent.

m. (-भिद् or भित्)
BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
यमुना the Yamunā, and भिद् divider; having divided the river into two parts with his ploughshare.

m. (-ता)
A name of YAMA.
E.
यमुना the Yamunā, and भ्रातृ brother.

f. (-का)
A Gong, a metal plate, or a large drum used to strike the hours or watches.

m. (-षः)
A cock.
f. (-षा)
A clock, a metal plate on which the hours are struck, or a drum used for a similar purpose.
E.
याम a watch, and घोष sound.

f. (-ली)
A metal plate on which the hours are struck, or a drum used for that purpose.
E.
याम a watch, and नाली the same instrument.

m. (-मिः)
A name of INDRA.

f. (-ती)
Night.
E.
याम a watch, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-ता)
A daughter's husband.
E.
य substituted for ज; see जामातृ.

f. (-मिः-मी)
1 A sister.
2 A virtuous woman.
3 Night.
4 The south.
5 A daughter, or daughter-in-law, newly married.
E.
या to go, मि aff., or य substituted for ज, see जामि, or यम YAMA, and अण् aff. of reference.

f. (-का)
Night.
E.
याम a watch, कन् aff., fem. form.

f. (-नी)
Night.
E.
याम a watch, इनि aff.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
यामिनी night, and पति master.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
f. (-रा)
Night.
E.
यामी night, रा to have or be, aff. क.

n. (-कं)
Lead.

m. (-यः)
A sister's son.
E.
यामि a sister, and ढक् aff.

m. (-म्यः)
1 Sandal.
2 The saint AGASTYA.
f. (-म्या)
1 The south.
2 The lunar asterism, Bharaṇī.
3 Night.
E.
यम YAMA, ण्यत् aff.; being sacred to or governed by that deity, &c.

n. (-नं)
The sun's course, south of the line.
E.
याम्य the south, अयन going.
